correctness.rationale: For any field, with three triangle vertices and r leaves attached at vertex1, edge brackets are the 2×2 minors of column-pairs h_i=(x_i,y_i). Nonzero triangle bivectors are decomposable in k^3, and if either a or b is nonzero the first column is nonzero and all leaf determinant equations may be set freely. If a=b=0,c≠0, then h2,h3 span k² and h1=0, forcing all leaf coefficients zero; if a=b=c=0 then nonzero h1 allows any leaf coefficients. This proves exact excluded set a=b=0,c≠0,d≠0. Every derived element is a sum of a triangle-only and a leaf-only bracket; z23+z14 witnesses width2 for r≥1, while r0 is width1. Over F_q, the prescribed nonzero 2×3 minors form an SL2(q) torsor of cardinal q(q²−1); divide into h1≠0/h1=0 and zero-minor strata to obtain all five displayed ordered-pair fiber cases and image size q^(r+3)−(q−1)(q^r−1). No division by two is required, including char2. Independently enumerated ALL vector pairs and target fibers at (q,r)=(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1), and matched all formulas. This finite validation supplements the all-field algebraic proof.
